description: Add Docker support (Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml), comprehensive README.md, and CI/CD workflow (.github/workflows/).
steps: Create multi-stage Dockerfile: stage 1 builds frontend (node:20-alpine), stage 2 installs Python deps and serves API + static frontend.
Create docker-compose.yml for easy local development.
Create comprehensive README.md with overview, features, quickstart (CLI/web/Docker), API docs, architecture, and contributing guide.
Create .github/workflows/ci.yml with lint, test, and Docker build steps.
acceptance_criteria: Dockerfile exists and uses multi-stage build
docker-compose.yml exists and references the Dockerfile
README.md is comprehensive with all documented sections
.github/workflows/ci.yml exists with lint, test, and docker build jobs
findings: All 46 pytest tests pass after adding static file serving to backend. Frontend builds cleanly. Docker build not tested locally (no Docker daemon in this environment) but Dockerfile syntax is valid.
